Artango: A Journey Through Argentine Flavor and Culture

At Artango Bar & Steakhouse, indulge in a rustic, flavorful menu filled with authentic Argentine dishes, including expertly prepared imported steaks that honor ancestral cooking techniques. Pair your meal with Prohibition-era cocktails and a curated selection of both classic and rare European and Argentine wines. Dining at Artango is more than just a meal—it's an immersive journey into the heart of Buenos Aires’ Golden Age.

Why You Should Grab The Offer

Nestled in the heart of Lincoln Square, Artango Bar & Steakhouse offers a vibrant celebration of authentic Argentine culture. Every dish is crafted using time-honored techniques, bringing the bold flavors of Buenos Aires to your plate. The rich Art Nouveau décor and the Prohibition-era cocktails set the stage for a memorable dining experience. With a thoughtfully curated wine list featuring European and Argentine selections, Artango combines culinary excellence with an unforgettable atmosphere.

But the experience doesn’t stop with just the food.

Iconic Trump International Hotel & Tower® Chicago

Escape to a world of relaxation at the renowned Trump International Hotel & Tower® Chicago, where this oasis of tranquility awaits. Unwind with a luxurious massage or rejuvenating facial — or both — designed to ease deep muscle tension, refresh your skin, and melt away stress. This isn't just a spa day; it's a transformative experience that leaves you feeling renewed and revitalized in every way.

What We Offer

Luxury Spa Day with Pool Access: 60-Min Renewal Massage OR 60-Min Facial for One with Glass of Bubbly; Valid Mon–Thurs (Excludes Holidays)

Choose your treatment: the Aroma Renewal Massage — a Swedish-style massage with aromatherapy oil and a refreshing peppermint scalp massage — or a 60-minute facial tailored to your skin's needs.

Luxury Spa Day with Pool Access: 60-Min Couples Massage for Two with Hot Stones and Glass of Bubbly; Valid Mon–Thurs (Excludes Holidays)

Gentle pressure, long smooth strokes, and the warmth of hot stones work together to improve circulation, ease tension, and deliver a welcome state of shared serenity.

Luxury Spa Day with Pool Access: Pampering Package — 60-Min Massage AND 60-Min Facial for One with Bubbly; Valid Mon–Thurs (Excludes Holidays)

All packages include full access to the 75-foot heated pool and the complete spa amenity suite — a modern gym with state-of-the-art equipment, steam room, sauna, and a relaxation lounge overlooking the Chicago River.

Plan to arrive at least 30 minutes before your appointment. We highly recommend spending the full day to make the most of everything the spa has to offer.

Guests must be 16 or older to use the Fitness Club. Guests under 16 must be accompanied by an adult (18+) to use the pool and locker room amenities.

These massage services include light to firm pressure massage techniques. Services can be upgraded to a therapeutic or deep tissue massage for an additional fee at the spa.

Why You Should Grab This Offer

Your spa day begins the moment you step into the serene retreat and are handed a chilled glass of bubbly. Whether you choose a tension-melting massage, a skin-renewing facial, or the full pampering package with both, every treatment is designed to leave you feeling weightless and restored.
